name: 48062 · Richmond, MI
findings: ZIP 48062 (Richmond) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48062 (Richmond) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48062 (Richmond) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.
